BrochureContent.Content:
Russell Estate Agents in association with Hegarty Properties are delighted to present this superb four-bedroom detached family home, occupying an enviable position in the highly sought-after coastal villages of Lower Aghada and Rostellan in East Cork. Enjoying breathtaking views across Cork Harbour, this impressive residence offers the perfect blend of generous living accommodation, picturesque surroundings, and an exceptional lifestyle in one of East Cork's most desirable locations. Located just 10 minutes from Midleton 30 minutes from Cork City this is an ideal opportunity to enjoy all the benefits of living in this wonderful community while still being an easy commute to the town and city.
The property extends to spacious and well-appointed accommodation, thoughtfully designed to maximise both comfort and the spectacular coastal outlook. Bright and welcoming reception rooms provide excellent space for everyday family living and entertaining, while large windows frame the ever-changing harbour views and flood the home with natural light. The well-equipped kitchen and dining area forms the heart of the home, complemented by four generously proportioned bedrooms, making it an ideal choice for growing families or those seeking additional space to work from home. Its excellent BER rating ensures it qualifies for the green mortgage. If you are looking for a spacious family home which offers impressive views across Cork harbour then this is the one for you.


ACCOMMODATION
Entrance Hallway
A bright and spacious entrance hallway with tiled flooring and window blinds.

Home Office / Study
The home office / study has a tiled floor and has extensive built in units and a window blind.

Guest W.C.
Fully tiled with wash hand basin, toilet and heated towel rail

Living Room
An L Shaped living room with wooden flooring and French doors leading out to the front of the house. The room enjoys harbour views. Window blinds are fitted and it was a velux window in the ceiling also.

Sitting Room
The sitting room has wooden flooring, a solid fuel fireplace and floor to ceiling windows enjoying wonderful harbour views.

Kitchen / Dining Room
A focal point of the house is this impressive kitchen // dining room with tiled flooring, stylish fitted kitchen and centre island with French doors leading you out onto the decking area overlooking the harbour. 

Utility Room
The utility room has a tiled floor, fitted units and is plumbed for washing machine etc. There is a door leading out to the side garden also.

First Floor Landing
Wooden flooring, access into the attic and hot-press.

Master Bedroom
A superb master suite enjoying wonderful harbour views from the floor to ceiling windows this double bedroom has wooden flooring, Ensuite and a walk- in wardrobe.

Ensuite
The ensuite is fully tiled and has a shower, toilet, wash hand basin and heated towel rail.

Walk in Wardrobe
Located in the master bedroom it has fitted shelving and rails.

Bedroom 2
A double bedroom with wooden flooring, sea views, window blinds, curtains and fitted wardrobes.

Bedroom 3
A double bedroom with wooden flooring, and velux window.

Shower Room
Located on the first floor it is fully tiled and has a shower, toilet and a floating vanity unit with sink.

Bedroom 4
A double bedroom with wooden flooring, velux window and fitted wardrobe.


OUTSIDE

The property is set on beautifully landscaped and exceptionally well-maintained gardens that have been thoughtfully designed to complement its stunning coastal setting. Predominantly laid to lawn, the grounds of circa 0.44 acres features a mix of colourful shrubs, and attractive planting, creating a private and tranquil environment throughout the year. A spacious decking area provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing while taking in the spectacular panoramic views across Cork Harbour. The generous gardens offer ample space for children to play, keen gardeners to enjoy, or for future enhancement, all while enjoying the peace and serenity of this exceptional waterfront location. The tarmac driveway provides ample parking making this an outstanding outdoor space that perfectly complements the quality of the home. 


LOCATION

Nestled on the shores of picturesque Cork Harbour, Rostellanand Lower Aghada are one of East Cork's most sought-after residential locations, renowned for its breathtaking coastal scenery, peaceful surroundings, and exceptional quality of life. This area offers the perfect balance of tranquil countryside living while remaining conveniently close to a host of amenities and excellent transport links.
The area is celebrated for its spectacular harbour views, scenic woodland walks, and access to a wide range of outdoor pursuits including sailing, tennis, GAA, soccer, rowing, kayaking, fishing, and coastal walks. The nearby Rostellan Woods and the shoreline provide an idyllic setting for nature lovers and those who enjoy an active outdoor lifestyle.
Families are well catered for, with excellent primary and secondary schools nearby, while the neighbouring villages of Whitegate and Aghada offer local shops, cafés, restaurants, sporting clubs, and everyday services. The bustling market town of Midleton, is just a short drive away and provides an extensive range of shopping, supermarkets, schools, restaurants, and leisure facilities.
Cork City is easily accessible in approximately 30 minutes, making this an ideal location for commuters seeking the peace and beauty of coastal living without compromising on convenience.


DIRECTIONS

From Midleton travel the R630 road to Whitegate. Continue ahead for 8 km. Once you pass through Rostellan village take the next road to the left and the property will be ahead on your right hand side.


VIEWING ARRANGEMENTS

All viewings of this property must be arranged through the selling agents. Our office hours are Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm. We can arrange evening and weekend viewings by prior appointment.


JOINT AGENTS

This property is being sold in conjunction with our joint agents Hegarty Properties.
